about_the_game:
A Magical Adventure in the Heart of Time!

What would happen if ten days vanished into thin air? Join Vicky, a curious and brave fox, on an unforgettable platforming adventure to solve a charming mystery! On the evening of October 4, 1582, time took an unexplainable leap, hiding ten precious days within 22 beautiful, magical Animal Cards. Scattered across enchanted realms full of charm and gentle challenges, it's now up to you to help Vicky find them all!

Along your path, you'll meet the "Muddlers," little creatures born from the temporal chaos. They are not enemies to be defeated! Vicky can help them find their calm with a gentle jump on their head. But be careful: their confusing touch can make Vicky lose a bit of her "Inner Time", but she can always get it back by finding the level's feather!

A Gentle Game Full of Discovery

  • Enchanting Exploration: Guide Vicky through colorful and evocative worlds, with graphics inspired by beloved animated films.

  • Wisdom to Discover: Each Animal Card reveals a positive and gentle message, inspired by the wisdom of the animal depicted. Themes like courage, patience, and friendship are presented in a simple and accessible way.

  • Intuitive Gameplay: Help Vicky jump, collect shimmering bunches of grapes (the energy of time!), and find precious colored feathers to unlock the path to new areas.

  • Non-Violent Interaction: Instead of fighting, help the confused creatures find their calm with a gentle jump, in a gameplay experience free of violence.

  • Perfect for the Whole Family: With its captivating story and uplifting messages, this game is designed to stimulate curiosity, empathy, and problem-solving skills in a serene and magical atmosphere.

Treat your children to a journey full of wonder, friendship, and gentle learning. Help Vicky put time back in its place!
